deskLastSessionFroze: The app stopped responding last time. Send the log?

@deskLastSessionFroze.description: Notice at start (phone and desktop), after unlock, once: the previous session froze (Android ANR). Offers to send that session's log in a problem report.

deskLastSessionClosed: The app closed unexpectedly last time. Send the log?

@deskLastSessionClosed.description: Notice at start (phone and desktop), after unlock, once: the previous session crashed or was ended without closing. Offers to send that session's log in a problem report.

@deskLastSessionSend.description: Button on the last-session notice: opens Report a problem with the previous session's log attached. Nothing is sent until the user sends the report.

@deskLastSessionNotNow.description: Button on the last-session notice: closes it; it does not come back for this incident.

@deskLastSessionReportFroze.description: Pre-filled text of the problem report opened from the last-session notice (froze case). The user can edit it.

@deskLastSessionReportClosed.description: Pre-filled text of the problem report opened from the last-session notice (crash case). The user can edit it.

deskLastSessionAttached: With the log of the last session.

@deskLastSessionAttached.description: Problem report form: line under the log switch when the report carries the previous session's log instead of the current one.
